name: Grinda
description: Grinda is a moderate 9.8 km clockwise SAT island loop with a public start/end at Södra Grinda ferry quay and a natural service-hub start option at Grinda Wärdshus. The route mixes gravel road, forest road, pasture edges, shoreline walking and more technical rocky/rooty trail on the northern and eastern/southeastern coast. Treat it as a nature-reserve loop with excellent seasonal services, but with strict rules for camping, fire and dogs.
utilities: SAT confirms toilets and water at the guest harbor and Grinda Sea Lodge, not during winter, but operator pages frame several utilities as seasonal, paid, harbor, lodging or customer services.

Länsstyrelsen explicitly says dry toilets exist at all bathing places and at Södra ångbåtsbryggan; iteration 3 keeps Södra water guarded and adds separate dry toilets for Södra, Källviken and Badviken/Norra.
Grinda Camping is the official/designated paid campsite with dry toilets, water pumps, waste handling, communal BBQ and high-season shower access via the guest-harbor service house.
Grinda Wärdshus, Lanthandel & Café, bakery, Framfickan, Sea Lodge, cottage village and guest-harbor services are seasonal, opening-hours dependent, customer/guest/fee-based or mixed-access.

Expose guest harbor and Sea Lodge toilet/water with not-winter plus fee/customer caveats; keep showers, electricity, waste, sauna, boat rentals, septic pump-out and many service-house details guarded unless later passes confirm broad public hiker access.
Default waste guidance should remain pack-out/mainland where possible; do not render customer/harbor environmental stations as ordinary trail litter service.
waterSources: Water at the guest harbor, not during winter per SAT; operator price list frames canister refill as paid harbor service, so include fee/customer caveat.
Water at Grinda Sea Lodge, not during winter per SAT; operator pages do not clearly prove broad public hiker access, so include current-hours/customer caveat.
Water pumps at the paid campsite; verify season and whether they are for camping guests.
Do not render Södra, Källviken or Badviken/Norra beach/toilet-point water from OSM alone; official sources currently verify dry toilets/bathing places rather than public drinking taps.
Carry water outside the main season or when businesses/service points may be closed.
notes: Route shape: clockwise island loop; step-by-step guide starts at Grinda Södra ferry quay, while the section page also describes Grinda Wärdshus as the natural start.
Use current SAT web/step-guide facts for public route scalar values: Moderate, 9.8 km, 3:30 and 55 m gain.
Do not import older official PDF, linked GPX/Outdooractive or secondary platform distances as canonical until later iterations reconcile the 8.1-8.9 km geometry conflict.
Follow blue/yellow SAT markings. AllTrails visitor reviews and third-party route maps report mismatch/signage issues; treat those as conflict discovery only.
Render accessMetadataDraft as the primary ferry layer; transit facilities are fallback only and should not render at the same time.
Grinda Norra must remain exact-date verified access because at least one secondary source reports it was not operating in June 2025.
Use Waxholmsbolaget v11 as the strongest current 2026 static evidence for both Grinda piers; do not imply v12/v13 serve Norra unless later current timetables prove it.
Use the stricter Grinda reserve rule for dogs: leashed year-round, despite less strict general SAT seasonal wording.
Länsstyrelsen/Explore Archipelago support exact designated grill coordinates at Södra Grinda and the tent site; keep them tied to designated-place and fire-ban caveats.
Do not store current fire-ban status as a static Grinda fact; always present as check-current-status guidance from Länsstyrelsen/Storstockholms brandförsvar.
Treat Strömma/Cinderella as separate-ticket seasonal access to Södra Grinda only, not as Waxholmsbolaget/SL access.
Iteration 3 models separate dry toilets at Södra Grinda/Södra bryggan, Källviken and Badviken/Norra; Södra/toilet-point drinking water remains unverified and guarded.
Public/customer boundaries matter: showers, electricity, sauna, waste, rentals and several toilets/taps may be customer, harbor or lodging services.
A defibrillator is documented at Grinda Wärdshus in SAT low-season material; keep it in emergencyMetadataDraft only because access depends on opening and circumstances.

Do not mechanically copy pendingFacilityDraft or emergencyMetadataDraft into app facilities; app integration must explicitly filter renderPolicy never_render_as_facility_or_poi and map only approved entries into TrailFacility shape.
Do not directly import fallback_only transit facilities into the app facilities layer when accessMetadataDraft is rendered; the app does not consume renderPolicy and would duplicate ferry markers.
Current app marker rendering has no clustering/spiderfy; use serviceClustersDraft or hub-style mapping for close Hemviken/guest-harbor and Sea Lodge facilities.
Several draft source URLs are intentionally stale/conflict evidence, such as Outdooractive returning 410 Gone; do not treat stale artifact URLs as live primary sources.
Suppress Grinda Säteri/mainland farm results; they are not the island Grinda Lantbruk.

facilities.name: Guest harbour toilet
facilities.description: Primary SAT-confirmed open toilet at the Hemviken/guest-harbor service hub, not available in winter. Operator material frames harbor toilets/service-house access in a harbor fee/service context, so do not present as unconditional year-round free utility. Showers and other harbor service-house features are customer/fee or seasonal metadata, not ordinary public trail utilities.

facilities.name: Water at guest harbour
facilities.description: SAT-confirmed water at the Hemviken/guest-harbor service hub, with operator material framing canister refill as a paid harbor service and fresh-water filling near piers. Verify current season, fee and service-house access before relying outside main season.

facilities.name: Grinda Sea Lodge toilet
facilities.description: SAT-confirmed open toilet at Grinda Sea Lodge on the southern/eastern side of the loop, not available in winter. Operator material supports Sea Lodge area toilets but frames many services in lodging/customer context, so current opening and public access should be checked.

facilities.name: Water at Grinda Sea Lodge
facilities.description: SAT-confirmed water at Grinda Sea Lodge. Operator material supports running-water sinks in the Sea Lodge area but mostly in accommodation context, so verify current season/opening before relying outside the Midsummer-to-mid-August public service period.

facilities.name: Grinda Camping
facilities.description: Designated paid campsite/tenting area. Official rules allow camping only at designated places; do not expose dispersed camping elsewhere on Grinda.

facilities.name: Södra Grinda dry toilet
facilities.description: Public dry toilet at/near Södra ångbåtsbryggan and Södra Grinda bathing area. Länsstyrelsen confirms dry toilets at all bathing places and at Södra ångbåtsbryggan; Explore Archipelago/Wikimedia/OSM secondary checks support this point.

facilities.name: Källviken dry toilet
facilities.description: Public dry toilet linked to Källviken bathing place. Länsstyrelsen confirms dry toilets at Grinda bathing places; Explore Archipelago service-map data and OSM secondary checks support this individual point. Do not infer drinking water from this toilet point.

facilities.name: Badviken / Norra Grinda dry toilet
facilities.description: Public dry toilet linked to the Badviken/Norra Grinda bathing area. Länsstyrelsen confirms dry toilets at Grinda bathing places; Explore Archipelago service-map data and OSM secondary checks support this individual point. Do not infer drinking water from this toilet point.

facilities.name: Grinda Wärdshus
facilities.description: Main food/lodging anchor near the loop and natural mid-island start option. Treat hotel/lodging functions as service context, not trail utility.

facilities.name: Grinda Lanthandel & Café
facilities.description: Shop/cafe/bakery service near Wärdshus, useful for groceries, picnic food, simple lunches and fresh bread when open.

facilities.name: Grinda Sea Lodge food service
facilities.description: Seasonal Sea Lodge food/lodging context with breakfast/lunch/dinner during individual/family periods. Other services such as showers, sauna and rentals are customer/paid metadata.

facilities.name: Grinda Bakery
facilities.description: Seasonal bakery/Bageriboden by the guest-harbor side. Useful for bread and breakfast-style supplies when open; keep Lanthandeln as the broader shop/cafe service.

facilities.name: Framfickan
facilities.description: Seasonal drop-in/takeaway food service by the guest harbor. Treat as current-hours-required service rather than dependable year-round resupply.

facilities.name: Södra Grinda ferry quay
facilities.description: Primary SAT Grinda trailhead and loop start/end. Transit fallback only; prefer accessMetadataDraft for rendering.

facilities.name: Norra Grinda ferry quay
facilities.description: Secondary Waxholmsbolaget access near the northern loop. Transit fallback only; verify current timetable and prefer accessMetadataDraft for rendering.

facilities.name: Designated fire area by camping
facilities.description: Designated fire/grill place by the tent site/camping area. Never imply fires are allowed outside designated places, and fire bans override static guidance.

facilities.name: Designated fire area near southern services
facilities.description: Designated fire/grill place at/near Södra Grinda. Never imply fires are allowed outside designated places, and fire bans override static guidance.

facilities.name: Klubbuddens utsiktsplats / Klubbudden viewpoint
facilities.description: Highest-point/view highlight on the eastern/southeastern technical part of the loop; Länsstyrelsen names Klubbudden as the island's about 35 m high viewpoint and Explore Archipelago has a service-map viewpoint at this coordinate. Treat as one viewpoint-style attraction, not a separate summit plus viewpoint pair.

facilities.name: Northwest viewpoint
facilities.description: Generic north/west/Hemviken-side viewpoint candidate. Do not rename this to Lilla utsikten; iteration 4 found Lilla utsikten is a different, secondary/guarded OSM/Komoot candidate.

facilities.name: Källviken beach
facilities.description: Sand beach/bathing cove, with Länsstyrelsen noting accessible entrance context. A separate Källviken dry-toilet facility is modeled in facilitiesDraft. Observe reserve rules and fire restrictions.

facilities.name: Badviken beach
facilities.description: North-side bathing POI near the northern access/service context. Länsstyrelsen and Explore Archipelago identify this as one of the primary bathing places, and a separate Badviken/Norra dry-toilet facility is modeled in facilitiesDraft.

facilities.name: Södra Grinda beach
facilities.description: Child-friendly southern swimming near Södra bryggan and the SAT start/end side. Länsstyrelsen notes accessible water-entry context at Södra bryggan.

facilities.name: Grinda Lantbruk
facilities.description: Farm/cultural-landscape context where grazing animals help maintain the reserve landscape. It is a valid nearby context point but not directly on the SAT line; do not confuse with mainland Grinda Säteri search results.

facilities.name: Grinda nature and culture trail
facilities.description: Secondary about 2.5 km nature/culture trail context around southeast Grinda, starting at gården Hemviken per Länsstyrelsen. Coordinate is only an approximate Hemviken/Wärdshus-area anchor and should not be used as an exact trailhead without better source data.
